1.title: Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review Balogun ban
1.summary: President Donald Trump confirms he asked Fifa to review United States striker Folarin Balogun's one-match suspension at the World Cup.

2.title: Trump Defends Asking FIFA to Review Folarin Balogun’s World Cup Ban
2.summary: The president said he called the head of FIFA but “didn’t tell him what to do.” The overturning of the ban has roiled soccer and brought renewed scrutiny to the relationship between the two leaders.

3.title: ‘Excited but Shocked’: U.S. Soccer Fans Struggle With Trump’s FIFA Call

6.title: Turkey Hosts NATO Summit While Cracking Down on Critics
